description: Turn study notes into flashcards, multiple-choice quizzes, and simplified cards using on-device AI. No external API key required.

tools.name: generate_flashcards
tools.description: Generate Q&A flashcard pairs from study notes or any block of text.

text.description: Study notes or text to generate flashcards from.

count.description: Number of flashcards to generate (1–20). Default: 5.

difficulty.description: Card difficulty: easy | medium | hard. Default: medium.

tools.name: generate_quiz
tools.description: Convert an array of flashcards into a multiple-choice quiz with 4 options and explanations.

count.description: Number of quiz questions to generate. Default: 5.

tools.name: simplify_card
tools.description: Rewrite a single flashcard in simpler language for a beginner or intermediate audience.

level.description: Target level: beginner | intermediate. Default: beginner.
